# VO Biz Suite

> VO Biz Suite (vobizsuite.io) is an all-in-one CRM and business management platform built for voice actors. Track auditions, manage clients, send invoices, and grow your VO career with AI-powered outreach tools.

## Site

- Home: https://vobizsuite.io/
- Guides: https://vobizsuite.io/guides
- Contact: https://vobizsuite.io/contact
- Pricing: https://vobizsuite.io/#pricing
- Privacy: https://vobizsuite.io/privacy
- Terms: https://vobizsuite.io/terms

## Product

VO Biz Suite helps voice actors run their business like a business:

- Client Hub for contacts and relationship history
- Submission / audition tracking
- Bookings and session management
- Professional invoicing and billing exports (including QBO/Xero-friendly CSV)
- AI outreach email writer, follow-ups, pitch generator, and VO business assistant
- Prospect Finder for discovering potential clients
- Plans: Launch, Momentum, and Command (see pricing on the homepage)
